items.text: Hey everyone,

We hope you're having a fantastic year so far! A big thanks to everyone who has continued to play A.I.L.A and leave feedback. We want to make sure we're giving you the best horror experience we possibly can, so we've made some more tweaks and improvements to boost your gameplay:

notes.title: Here's what's been fixed in the latest patch

items.text: Key rebind for mouse and keyboard has been added
Fixed camera getting stuck looking at the ceiling
The knife model in a stealth kill completely passes through the zombie's head, this has been fixed
Fixed black liquid stun affecting players when interacting with in-game PC on Suicidal Forest
Tutorial pop-up text for Block Action now fits inside the screen frame on Steam Deck
Upscaler sharpness setting not applicable when changed through options menu, this has been fixed
New Game now resets play time on save files
Fixed player being able to take Skull key and Lever without solving weights puzzle
Gate can be interacted with on returning to First Village on Medieval level, this has been fixed
Tutorial pop-up text for healing and block doesn't overlap anymore
The saber model was missing in the hand while the rope cutting animation is playing on the Ghost Ship level, this has been fixed
When the first time climbing over the barrier in the Ghost Ship level with a saber in hands, the mesh of the saber disappears, this has been fixed
The selected language in the settings menu now corresponds to the system language
Traditional Chinese now supported
Pulsatrix
Hey everyone,

Thank you SO much for all your support since launch. We’ve loved reading all your comments and reviews, and it’s helped us loads with bug fixing and polishing. After a busy week working on our game, we’re now ready to launch our post-launch patch! Here’s what’s been corrected thanks to your feedback:
Crash that occurred on AMD chips in White World levels
Steam Deck not saving the options menu settings
Reduced the amount of health that bosses have by 20%
Improved the weapon accuracy
Weapon system balancing
Improved the controller dead zone adjustments
Inventory now closes when the death screen is shown to the player
Prevent accessing Samuel’s PC with an item in hand
Aim assist is now turned on by default when using the controller on PC
A debug function was enabled on the White World levels, allowing the player to press “V” and use a free cam mode
Fixed a performance spike after inserting VHS tape on Recap level
Witch's attack on the battleground triggered after loading the First Village save file on Medieval level
It was possible to interact with puzzle elements (candles) after solving the puzzle on Ghost ship level
Fixed a performance drop in the Captain's cabin on the Ghost Ship level
Controller scheme for Xbox was shown when playing with a PS controller
Battle music does not start after the enemy is triggered in the Forest level
Increased the damage after using the black liquid in the Forest level
Increased the time on screen for tutorial messages
QTE of the black liquid in the Forest level was present in some cinematics
Improved feedback on the impact of firearms
Sometimes the critical hit feedback was not shown

NPCs animation were cropping when selecting a dialogue choice too fast: We’ve had so much fun working on A.I.L.A and we hope these changes help improve your gameplay experience.: Pulsatrix [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157523/ec693217d4b0c233b73ed098f0b58209e1346cdf.jpg"]
Hey everyone,

A.I.L.A is releasing this year and we're hard at work bug fixing and polishing! It's been so much fun working on our second horror game, and really rewarding seeing how far we've come since launching Fobia - St. Dinfna Hotel back in 2022.

notes.title: Check out our latest dev commentary!

items.text: As some of you might know, MaxMRM is our Creative Director, and he's narrated our dev commentary trailer. This is a deep dive into what to expect from A.I.L.A, and gives a closer look at the story and the game's main character, Samuel. There's also some unseen before gameplay footage, so it's worth watching if you're eager to see more of what we've been creating!

We've also taken some new screenshots which we wanted to share. These show some of the different scenarios Samuel encounters. A.I.L.A is a psychological horror game, but you'll find there's definitely elements of survival and threats throughout!
Do you have any questions about A.I.L.A? Would you like to know more about our development journey or what's coming to the game? Let us know in the comments and we'll work on a Q&A.
Pulsatrix Studios
